_comment: Canonical HUD kit palette. Measured from existing chrome PNGs in assets/hud/. Hex values are absolute; sample tolerance is +/-2 per channel for drift detection.

canvas._comment_for_margin: Per AGENTS.md rule 4: max subject dim <= 104 px on 128 canvas, 12 px margin, perimeter alpha=0.

highlights._comment: A 1-px hi-light along top + left edges simulates light from upper-left. Boost = lighter shade added on top of body rgb.

borders._comment: All panels/buttons get a 2-px darker outline.

corners._comment: All rounded chrome uses 8 px corner radius on 128 canvas.

hero_distance._comment: When _validate_palette samples the body pixel of any kit sprite, the deviation from the canonical hex must not exceed this value in any RGB channel.
